problem.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problem.statement: Given a string s, return the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.
problem.constraints: 0 <= s.length <= 5 * 10^4; s may contain letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
problem.optimal_space: O(min(n, k)) for alphabet size k

events.text: I need the length of the longest substring with all distinct characters. What approaches are there?
Brute force checks every substring, O(n^3). A sliding window with a last-seen map is O(n).
I'll go with the faster one. Any pitfalls in how I update state?
Update the result after adjusting your pointers or map, not before.
What edge cases should I check now that my code passes the examples?
Try the smallest inputs, duplicates, and the boundaries described in the constraints.
